name: Productcategory count matches m_product_category, tenant-scoped
note: Coverage for a cube nothing had queried. The last two such cubes - Storage and Uom - turned out to carry a hardcoded tenant and an excluded-system-rows filter respectively, both invisible until something asked them for a number.
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM m_product_category WHERE ad_client_id IN (1000026,0)
